items.q: The statement “the excavation in which a strip foundation is placed” describes which of the following?

Damp proof membrane

Gypsum board
items.s: Reinforced concrete is concrete containing steel bars that carry the tensile force concrete cannot.

natural rock shaped for walling, flooring or facing
the common ribbed reinforcing bar used in concrete members
a block moulded from cement and sand, used for walls
items.s: Handover: the formal passing of the completed building to the client. The other options describe Sandcrete block, Stone, Mild steel bar.

items.q: The statement “a wall that carries load from above in addition to its own weight” describes which of the following?

Sill
Barge board

Timber

items.q: A load bearing wall 10 m long carries 200 kN per metre. If the strip footing provides 1 m2 of bearing area per metre of wall, what is the average pressure on the soil, in kN/m2?
items.s: Total load = 200 x 10 = 2000 kN, carried by 10 x 1 = 10 m2, so pressure = 2000 kN/m2.

items.q: A concrete slab measures 5 m by 0.75 m and is 0.1 m thick. What volume of concrete is needed, in cubic metres?
A wall of net area 40 m2 is built with blocks measuring 0.4 m by 0.2 m on the face. How many blocks are required?
items.s: Blocks per m2 = 1/(0.4 x 0.2) = 12.5, so required = 40 x 12.5 = 500 blocks.

items.q: A wall is 6 m long and 2.7 m high and contains 3 openings each 1.2 m by 2.1 m. What is its net area, in square metres?
items.s: Gross area = 6 x 2.7 = 16.2 m2. Openings = 3 x 1.2 x 2.1 = 7.56 m2, so net = 8.64 m2.

items.q: A wall area of 120 m2 receives 2 coats of paint at a coverage of 10 m2 per litre. How many litres are needed?
items.s: Litres = (area x coats)/coverage = (120 x 2)/10 = 24 litres.

items.q: A floor of 9 m2 is to be finished with square tiles of side 0.4 m. How many whole tiles are needed, ignoring waste?
items.s: Tile area = 0.4 x 0.4 = 0.16 m2, so tiles = 9/0.16 = 56.

items.s: Volume = 5 x 5 x 0.1 = 2.5 m3.

the temporary working platform erected around a building under construction
